title: Better Spawnpoint
description: Extends /spawnpoint to work across all dimensions — Nether, End, and modded worlds.
body:
Better Spawnpoint extends the vanilla /spawnpoint command to work across all dimensions — including the Nether, the End, and any modded dimension.
Features:

Set your spawnpoint in any dimension
On death, you will be teleported back to the correct dimension
Spawnpoint is saved and survives server restarts
If the spawnpoint block is destroyed, the mod falls back to vanilla behavior gracefully

Commands:

/spawnpoint — set spawn at your current position
/spawnpoint <targets> <pos> <angle> — full syntax
/spawnpoint clear — reset to world spawn

Requires Fabric API. Permission level 2 (operator) required.
